This page lists the spec and status fields of Namespace, ResourceGroup and WorkerNode, each with its type, its limits and its description. The [Platform page](../../../platform/tenancy-and-limits/namespaces.md) explains the concept, and the `metadata` of every kind is [the same](../../common-definitions.md#objectmeta).

## Namespace

::include[../../../../../api/types/v1alpha1/examples/namespaces/namespace.yaml#namespace]

| apiVersion | kind |
| --- | --- |
| `funcd.io/v1alpha1` | `Namespace` |

### `Namespace.spec`

| Field | Type and limits | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `defaultExposure` | string, one of `""`, `implicit`, `explicit` | Whether the namespace's Functions and Sites answer at their own address, such as /function/&lt;name&gt;, while their spec.ingress.enabled is unset: implicit, or empty, turns it on, and explicit turns it off. The namespace's other Routes, an App's included, stay on, though in the default namespace explicit refuses one with no host (HostRequired). |
| `edgeDefaults` | object, [`Namespace.spec.edgeDefaults`](#namespacespecedgedefaults) | The namespace's edge defaults, which apply where a Route or a Function's or Site's spec.ingress sets no value of its own. |
| `node` | string, a DNS-1123 label | The worker node that runs the namespace: its workers, its edge and its stores. It names a WorkerNode, which may be declared before its machine joins; the namespace then waits for it. Empty means the local node of an all-in-one funcd. The node of a namespace that holds objects cannot change. |
| `volumeBudget` | string, a size: 1 to 15 digits and an optional binary unit, Ki, Mi, Gi or Ti, with or without a B (512Ki, 2GiB) | The most volume space the namespace's Functions may reserve: each local volume's size from apply until the volume is removed, and each worker's emptyDir while the worker exists. Apply refuses a local volume that does not fit (VolumeBudget), and a worker whose emptyDir does not fit is not created. Set volumeBudget or volumeBudgetBytes, not both; neither, or 0, means no budget. |
| `volumeBudgetBytes` | integer, at least 0 | The same budget as volumeBudget, as a number of bytes. Set volumeBudget or volumeBudgetBytes, not both; 0 means no budget. |

### `Namespace.spec.edgeDefaults`

| Field | Type and limits | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `auth` | object, [`Namespace.spec.edgeDefaults.auth`](#namespacespecedgedefaultsauth) | The default edge authentication of the namespace's Routes and of its Functions' and Sites' own addresses, used where a rule, its Route and spec.ingress.auth set none; unset is open. It is a default, not a floor: a rule or a Route that sets open stays open. |

### `Namespace.spec.edgeDefaults.auth`

| Field | Type and limits | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `mode` | string, one of `""`, `authenticated`, `open`, `oidc` | authenticated admits only a caller whose token, sent as Authorization: Bearer or X-Api-Key, may get the namespace's Functions; others get 401 or 403, and every caller gets 401 while server.auth.edge is off. oidc signs callers in with the OIDCProvider that provider names. open, or empty, admits anyone. It reaches no Lake's or add-on object's address. |
| `provider` | string, a DNS-1123 label | With mode oidc, the OIDCProvider of the namespace that signs callers in; required with oidc and refused with another mode. The namespace shows a ProviderNotFound condition while it names no OIDCProvider. |
| `unauthenticated` | string, one of `""`, `redirect`, `401`, `allow` | With mode oidc, what a call that is not signed in gets: redirect, the default, 401 or allow, as on a Route's auth. Refused with another mode. |

### `Namespace.status`

| Field | Type and limits | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `conditions` | array of [Condition](../../common-definitions.md#condition) | The conditions that explain the phase. |
| `observedGeneration` | integer | The generation of the spec that funcd last acted on. |
| `phase` | string, one of `Pending`, `Deploying`, `Ready`, `Idle`, `Degraded`, `Failed`, `Terminating` | Where the object is in its lifecycle. |

## WorkerNode

| apiVersion | kind |
| --- | --- |
| `funcd.io/v1alpha1` | `WorkerNode` |

### `WorkerNode.status`

| Field | Type and limits | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `backup` | object, [`WorkerNode.status.backup`](#workernodestatusbackup) | The backup of the node's own stores, as the node last reported it; absent while the node runs no backup. |
| `blobStore` | string | The address of the node's blob store, as the node last reported it: its blob.target, or the file:// URL of its blob.dir. A BackupSchedule of a namespace on the node writes outside it. |
| `certificate` | object, [`WorkerNode.status.certificate`](#workernodestatuscertificate) | The node certificate that the control plane issued when the node joined. |
| `conditions` | array of [Condition](../../common-definitions.md#condition) | The conditions that explain the phase. |
| `lastSeen` | string, an RFC3339 UTC timestamp with exactly 3 fractional digits (2026-10-07T20:03:35.965Z) | When the node last polled the control plane. |
| `nodeAPIVersion` | integer | The version of the node API that the node speaks. |
| `observedGeneration` | integer | The generation of the spec that funcd last acted on. |
| `pendingJoin` | object, [`WorkerNode.status.pendingJoin`](#workernodestatuspendingjoin) | The one-time join token minted for the node and not used yet, kept as a hash. |
| `phase` | string, one of `Pending`, `Deploying`, `Ready`, `Idle`, `Degraded`, `Failed`, `Terminating` | Where the object is in its lifecycle. |
| `platform` | string | The OS and CPU of the node, such as linux/arm64. |
| `renewedCertificate` | object, [`WorkerNode.status.certificate`](#workernodestatuscertificate) | The certificate that the node asked for in place of its own, in the last third of its life; it becomes certificate once the node uses it. |
| `version` | string | The funcd release that the node runs, as it reported it. |

### `WorkerNode.status.backup`

| Field | Type and limits | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `held` | boolean | True while the node is held: its backups wait for the release. |
| `lastFailure` | string | Why the node's last run failed since the node started; a run that succeeds clears it. |
| `lastSuccessTime` | string, an RFC3339 UTC timestamp with exactly 3 fractional digits (2026-10-07T20:03:35.965Z) | When the node's newest complete generation was written. |
| `nextRunTime` | string, an RFC3339 UTC timestamp with exactly 3 fractional digits (2026-10-07T20:03:35.965Z) | When the node's next run is due. |
| `rpoRisk` | boolean | True when no verified generation of the node is newer than its backup.objectives.rpo. |

### `WorkerNode.status.certificate`

| Field | Type and limits | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `issuedAt` | string, required, an RFC3339 UTC timestamp with exactly 3 fractional digits (2026-10-07T20:03:35.965Z) | When the node joined and got the certificate. |
| `notAfter` | string, required, an RFC3339 UTC timestamp with exactly 3 fractional digits (2026-10-07T20:03:35.965Z) | When the certificate expires. |
| `serial` | string, required | The certificate's serial number, in hexadecimal. The control plane accepts only this certificate from the node. |

### `WorkerNode.status.pendingJoin`

| Field | Type and limits | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `expiresAt` | string, required, an RFC3339 UTC timestamp with exactly 3 fractional digits (2026-10-07T20:03:35.965Z) | When the token stops working. |
| `tokenHash` | string, required | The SHA-256 of the token's secret part, in hexadecimal. |
